component.name: WPS Office CN
WPS Office 国内版
component.summary: Office suite for documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF (China edition)
处理文档、表格、演示和 PDF 的办公套件（国内版）

developer.name: Zhuhai Kingsoft Office Software Co., Ltd.
珠海金山办公软件有限公司

description.p: This is a community package that repackages the official WPS Office for Linux build (mainland China edition, from linux.wps.cn) unmodified. It is not verified by, affiliated with, or supported by Kingsoft Office.

WPS Office combines Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation and PDF tools in one suite. It opens, edits and saves Microsoft Office files (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) as well as its own formats. This edition signs in with a mainland China WPS account and uses its cloud documents; its interface is Chinese and English. For the international edition, install com.wps.Office.
本包为社区打包，原样重新打包 WPS Office Linux 官方安装包（国内版，来自 linux.wps.cn），未经金山办公认证，与其无关，也不由其提供支持。
WPS Office 集文字、表格、演示和 PDF 于一体，可打开、编辑和保存 Microsoft Office 文件（DOCX、XLSX、PPTX）及 WPS 自有格式。本版本使用国内 WPS 账号登录和云文档，界面为中文和英文。国际版请安装 com.wps.Office。
The package adds a single WPS Office launcher. Documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs all open in the combined WPS Office window.

WPS Office runs on X11 (XWayland on a Wayland session). It can open and save files in Documents, Downloads and Desktop. A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Your whole home folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home cn.wps.linux
USB drives and other removable media: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media --filesystem=/media cn.wps.linux
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset cn.wps.linux
